title: Student Work
about: Four years of studio coursework in Industrial Design at Srishti — spanning furniture design, bamboo and sustainable-material exploration, garment construction, model making and prototyping, and briefs like Semantics of Product Design and New Ways of Making. This is a survey of that period: less a single project than a record of the range of materials, methods, and questions that shaped how I think about design, well before Karya, Studio Wood, or the rest of this list.
tools: Wood, textile, bamboo, and mixed-material fabrication
